title: Story Time at Graddy's Playhouse
seo_title: Story Time at Graddy's Playhouse in Springfield, MO
description: Story Time at Graddy's Playhouse is a morning of reading books about home with Adam Graddy's real estate team, plus time to explore the new exhibit. The playhouse has hands-on STEM activities and interactive pretend play spaces, including a real-life kitchen, living room, and backyard, and the event is listed under kids. It takes place Friday, December 4, 2026 at 10:30 AM at the Discovery Center of Springfield, 438 E. St. Louis St., Springfield, MO, and repeats every first Friday of the month at 10:30.
venue: Graddy's Playhouse at the Discovery Center of Springfield
